module: Flowgraph node "Raceline Parking" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Checks that a vehicle is parked in a spot defined by position/rotation/scale (the scale gives half-width x, length y and depth z). Computes dotAngle, forward, sideDistance, forwardDistance (based on the center of the two front wheels) and detects stopping (speed <= 0.05 m/s for stop_timer seconds). Draws a colored debug volume in the world and, if the imgui pin is true, a 2D imgui preview.
notes: Bug: checkParking reads self.pinIn.vehicleID whereas the pin is named vehId: this pin is ignored and the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) is always the one tracked. drawImgui also always uses the player's vehicle.
getTwoSmallestValues returns the same wheel twice if the number of wheels is odd.
drawDebug references the global variable drawMode, probably nil (alpha 0.25).
Default rotation values quat(0,0,0,0) (invalid) if the pin is not connected.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets stopTimer to nil when the graph starts.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets stopTimer to nil when the graph stops.

work.desc: On clear, resets the outputs to nil; on flow, calls checkParking, drawDebug and optionally drawImgui.

toInternal2d.desc: Converts a world position into 2D coordinates of the imgui preview, relative to the spot.

drawLine.desc: Draws a 2D polyline in the current ImDrawList.

worldLineToMapLine.desc: Converts a list of world points into 2D preview points (table reused between calls).

drawImgui.desc: Draws the 280x300 imgui preview: spot edges (green/yellow/red), vehicle outline, front axle and stop progress circle.

checkParking.desc: Computes the outputs (dotAngle, forward, sideDistance, forwardDistance, inside, stopping, stoppedPercent, stopped) for the tracked vehicle.

getVehicleFrontwheelsCenterPosition.desc: Returns the center of the two frontmost wheels, then the position of each wheel (vec3), or nothing if vehicle/pos is nil.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

drawDebug.desc: Draws with debugDrawer semi-transparent triangles (spot box, left/right sides) colored according to the state.
